title: XR Guild proposes an AI librarian for its ethics-resource collection
summary: XR Guild proposes an AI librarian to find ethics resources; public catalog pages also show ChatGPT-attributed keywords, but improved discovery remains unmeasured.
account: In a June 18, 2024 interview, XR Guild founder Avi Bar-Zeev described plans for an AI librarian that would return relevant papers and postmortems in response to ethical dilemmas, conditional on reliable retrieval. The Guild's annual report describes a 2025 library refresh with 220 resources. A public library entry visibly attributes its keywords to ChatGPT. These sources establish a proposed assistant and some AI-associated metadata work, but do not establish that the proposed librarian was deployed or that AI improved retrieval, learning, or ethical decisions. The 2022 date displayed on that library entry belongs to the underlying video, not the AI metadata.
purpose: The proposed assistant would help professionals locate evidence about ethical dilemmas in the Guild library.
system: Proposed XR Guild AI librarian; ChatGPT-attributed catalog keywords; model versions unspecified
developer: XR Guild volunteers; AI platform developer unspecified for proposed librarian
domain: Library discovery and professional ethics resources

value.text: In a June 18, 2024 interview, XR Guild founder Avi Bar-Zeev described plans for an AI librarian that would return relevant papers and postmortems in response to ethical dilemmas, conditional on reliable retrieval. The Guild's annual report describes a 2025 library refresh with 220 resources. A public library entry visibly attributes its keywords to ChatGPT. These sources establish a proposed assistant and some AI-associated metadata work, but do not establish that the proposed librarian was deployed or that AI improved retrieval, learning, or ethical decisions. The 2022 date displayed on that library entry belongs to the underlying video, not the AI metadata.
